question: Should `runChannelProbe` become a supported long-term Plugin SDK API for external plugins, or should this deduplication remain limited to bundled channel implementations?
rationale: The refactor requires a shared importable seam across bundled plugins, but exporting it from a public SDK module establishes a compatibility contract beyond the immediate cleanup.

options.title: Adopt the SDK contract
options.body: Approve `runChannelProbe` as a supported Plugin SDK helper and add the contract-level documentation or coverage that defines its timeout and error behavior.

options.title: Keep it bundled-only
options.body: Use an approved bundled-plugin seam so this refactor does not create a new external SDK promise.

recommendation.title: Adopt the SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve `runChannelProbe` as a supported Plugin SDK helper and add the contract-level documentation or coverage that defines its timeout and error behavior.
